title: Anonymous industrial shorter download path win

change.control: Three-step download path moves from product introduction to returning-user login and then new-user registration.
change.variant: Move registration and email capture to the first step, provide returning-user link instead of mandatory login step, remove general-information heading and align headline with button copy.

significance.reported: Source reports significantly higher conversions; numeric confidence not supplied.

quote: The treatment outperformed the control by 364%.
notes: Case Study 2, a follow-up to the registration-form experiment. Published rates were 2.13% versus 9.89%; preserve reported 364% rather than recomputing. The article calls the increase significant but does not quantify confidence. This is not the separate sequential shutter-retailer example. Allocation method is not explicitly restated for Case Study 2, so this is conservatively classified as research rather than a confirmed randomized A/B test.
